title: Chapter 1084
paragraphs: Chapter 1084
Episode 255. The Death of Kelliark Zipple, and....(1)
“Kaaaaak!”
Kelliark let out a monstrous scream.

The fact that he had kept a powerful shield around his entire body now turned out to be a bad move. The wound on his severed shoulder was horrific and rough, not as if it were cut by a sword, but as if it were torn off by hand.

His arm was cut off, and he had dropped his weapon. Although mages were less dependent on their weapons compared to warriors, the battle, which he was already losing, now had not a single shred of a chance for a reversal.
Booooom-!

Still, Kelliark took the opportunity of Jin's strike to cast a spatial explosion right in front of his face. Originally, he had wanted to blow his head right off, but Jin never allowed a direct hit from a spatial explosion. He had been predicting and dodging Kelliark's actions throughout the entire fight.
'Still, this one is deep!'
Kelliark judged as such.
He thought it would surely be enough to deal some damage, perhaps even inflict a wound deep enough to tear off a part of his face.
'If not, there's no reason for his follow-up attack to be this late. First, I must retrieve my staff...'
The moment he thought that far and bent down to pick up his staff, Kelliark flinched at the sensation of the floor beneath his feet giving way.
Krr-crack, craaaaaack...!
The floor was splitting. The place where Jin's sword had just passed—it wasn't just the floor of the central area that was splitting.
'He bisected the entire tower!?'
A chill ran down his spine. His left hand, which had been trying to grab the staff again, grasped at empty air, missing by a hand's breadth due to the sudden gap created as the tower split.

Kelliark's body was also tilting diagonally in the direction the tower began to collapse. The staff had already fallen into the darkness between the split and disappeared, and the Tower of Story began to fall like a sinking ship.
The symbol of the Zipple for the past thousands of years, their very heart, was splitting in half as it fell to the ground.
“Huuu.”

Unlike Kelliark, who was engulfed in shock, Jin calmly caught his breath. The reason his follow-up attack on Kelliark was late was simply because he had used too much power in an instant to cut the Tower of Story.
The tower's final defense systems were activating. All sorts of defensive artifacts that, in the past, only the Zipple could enjoy, were sounding alarms and emitting magic.
However, most of them were already in a state of severe damage. The outer armor had almost no intact parts left due to the enhanced Eternal Flames and the Golden Fleet's bombardment.

Sharp rays of magic flew in from all directions. Jin didn't even need to dodge. The hundreds of rays, far from reaching his shield, couldn't even penetrate the heat of the Eternal Flames and scattered in vain.

“How laughable is this, Kelliark Zipple. The fact that the man who is the leader of the world's greatest family was, in truth, nothing more than a coward who had laid out a bunch of meaningless defensive artifacts in his home. When a situation like this arrived, did you think these things could protect you even a little?”
Kelliark did not answer and glared forward.
He could not confirm Jin's form, blinded by the light created by the Eternal Flames, the Sun energy, and the Golden Fleet's bombardment.
It felt as if someone was pounding on his heart with a hammer.

Kelliark had felt the exact same emotion as he was feeling now, facing Jin, just once before in his life. It was the day in his youth when he had directly confronted Siron Runcandel and had barely escaped with his life.
A sense of defeat, and terror.
The fear that this was truly the end.
'He is stronger than the Chiron of that time...'
Although he couldn't see him, he felt as if he could hear the footsteps of Jin striding towards him through the chaotic light.
He couldn't even feel the pain of the wound where the Eternal Flames had stuck and was continuously burning. All of Kelliark's nerves were focused solely on Jin.
This time, there was nowhere to run like back then.
There was truly no path of retreat. The mages of his family were being massacred by the enemies' swords, and the escape route had been closed from the beginning.
The Tower of Story was falling, and the Origin Stone, Malugia, had abandoned him. The possibility of continuing to fight and defeating Jin did not exist at all.
If there was anything that could be called a variable, it was only the support of the Demon Army.
“Your eyes are dazed, Kelliark Zipple. But within them, a vain hope still remains. It must be because you are counting on the support of the Demon Army.”
Jin appeared through the chaotic light.
He looked perfectly fine, with only a few minor scratches. Unbelievably so for someone who had been fighting a man who was a giant and a pillar of the mortal world for a long time.

“But you should know better than anyone. That if they intended to help you, they would have arrived before it came to this. You have arrogantly thought that the entire world was beneath your feet... but look, this is your true face.”
The Tower of Story was approaching the ground. A few large chunks had already fallen into the golden sea and sunk.

Jin felt as if he had finally cornered the culprit after a long chase. The appearance of the culprit who had manipulated history, toyed with the world, and driven countless innocent people to their deaths was a shabby old fossil.

A face full of the dirty wrinkles characteristic of those who have aged while defying providence and accumulating evil; eyes that must have once shone frighteningly with greed like a starved beast were now just terrified. His one remaining arm hung limply, trembling.
His shadow was dark and long, staining the floor as if showing his past dark and dirty life.
“Jin Runcandel... are you going to kill me?”
Jin, who had just stepped on Kelliark's shadow, flinched at those words and his eyes widened.
“What did you say? Are you... begging for your life right now...?”
He had long predicted that his end would be a miserable one.
He had vowed and resolved for a long time that he would surely make him meet a miserable end. Since the dawn of history, he was the worst war criminal and murderer.
He was a monster who had blasphemed the world and history countless times by using the means of history manipulation, and a horrific father who had used his young children as test subjects.
Evil itself.
Until he crumbled before Jin's sword in this place, he was certainly the incarnation of power who had controlled the world with one hand.
And that Kelliark Zipple was now begging for his harmful life.
Jin could not believe it and stared at him blankly for a while.

“There are... more Origin Stones. Origin Stones that are under construction. You want to save the people I have killed, don't you? If those Origin Stones are completed, that much is certainly possible.”
“It feels like my ears are going to rot.”
“If you kill me, those Origin Stones cannot be completed. While fighting our Zipple, you have experienced more than anyone the return of countless of the dead. You saw it with your own two eyes.”
Sgeok-!
Jin cut off Kelliark's remaining arm. He fell to the floor like a stick, then barely managed to raise his body and look up at Jin again.

“Furthermore, I also have the authority I took from Zito. You will remember. The moment I acquired Zito's final authority. If that power is also combined with the Origin Stone, I can revive the demons who died in the Great Demon World War. So, can you kill me, disregarding all of this?”
Hahahahaha...!
Suddenly, Kelliark burst into laughter like a madman.
And at that moment, the Tower of Story finally ended its long fall and crashed down onto the golden sea.
Although it had been exploding and tearing apart during its fall, the Tower of Story was still massive enough to overturn the golden sea in an instant.

An immense impact arrived, but thanks to the energy of the Eternal Flames and his shield, Jin did not lose his balance. Kelliark was bounced around like a ball, his body bursting and breaking in various places, but his breath was not cut off.
A tidal wave shot up along the four sides of the tower.
Jin looked at the tidal wave spreading behind Kelliark, and he could see the water that had been shining gold until just now turning a green hue.
It was a color that Jin had already seen once in the past.
'...The Holy Land?'
The Holy Land of the Zipple, which he had seen when he went to save Valeria. The place where Elona Zipple was born from the 'Tree' 2500 years ago.

The Zipple had begun to move the Holy Land to the Tower of Story from the moment Kelliark returned, and now that the tower was completely destroyed, the hidden Holy Land was being revealed. The entire sea in the area was already dyed green.
“Kggghh...!”
Just as Valeria, as a Perfect Mana Body, had recovered from a fatal wound in the Holy Land, Kelliark's body, who was letting out a groan, could be seen slowly regenerating.
However, since he had only imitated a Perfect Mana Body with the power of Shinu and the incomplete Origin Stone, the recovery was not very fast. Kelliark still had no way out.
“Keuk, huhu... Are you really going to kill me and take away their chance to be resurrected? Can you really do such a thing?”
Kiiiiiiiii...!
From all over the sea, which had turned a verdant green with the power of the Holy Land, the monstrous screams of the Origin Stones could be heard. It was a monstrous scream layered in many folds.
Unfinished Origin Stones were appearing above the sea. Although Malugia's power could not be added, they were certainly Origin Stones.
Jin could feel it intuitively. That if those Origin Stones were completed, he could really revive the dead as Kelliark said.
“Hah, Kelliark Zipple... Are you serious? Do you seriously believe that I will let you live because of those Origin Stones?”
Jin said, kicking Kelliark in the knee. The shattered kneecap broke through the flesh and shot out, and he couldn't even sit down, sticking to the floor like a worm.
“Or did you think I would waver even a little? On the contrary, these Origin Stones are just another reason why you must be eliminated from this world.”

“Yes... then it is a pity. But even if you kill me, you have not won. After all, what awaits you too is only ruin and the apocalypse! Kill me. No, I don't want to die... Save me! If you just let me live, I will do anything. Hahahaha....”
Jin grabbed Kelliark's head. Below his blood-stained face, the scar left on his neck could be seen.
That scar was the imprint left by Malugia. Jin recognized that the shining Sun energy in the scar was Malugia's.
“Kelliark Zipple. You will suffer to the very end in the Runcandel underground prison, and die while confessing everything. As of today... your Zipple is finished.”

“I am used to surviving while enduring pain. Do you know? As long as one is alive, one can do anything. As long as one does not miss the opportunity! I have already climbed back from hell. Fuhuhu, hic, sob, keo... keok...!”
Kelliark, who had been bursting into laughter, suddenly let out a groan as if he were choking. Jin flinched and looked at the scar left on his neck.
Puk-!
The scar flashed for a moment and then exploded, blowing Kelliark's head apart.
Jin reflexively created distance and looked at Kelliark's corpse, which was now just a stick-like body. The corpse split open, and from within, a dimensional gate was seen opening.
“The air of the 677th dimension... is turbid and unpleasant to the extreme.”
A figure who shook his head as he emerged from the dimensional gate.
He was the leader of the Demon Army, Kelliark Zipple of the 33rd dimension.
